# Omkar Shubham Garden — Wedding & Celebration Venue, Khanapur, Karnataka

> Premier open-garden venue near Khanapur, Karnataka for weddings, receptions, and all family celebrations. 15+ years of family trust. 4.9/5 rating from 320+ Google reviews.

https://omkarshubhamgarden.com/

## Business Identity

- Domain: omkarshubhamgarden.com

## Location
- Address: Near Ramgurwardi Cross, Jamboti Road, Khanapur, Karnataka 591302, India

## Facilities Included in Booking
- 2 Maharaja (VIP) chairs
- 600 plastic chairs
- Catering utensils and vessels for up to 2,000 guests
- Cooking stoves
- 30 dining tables
- Homkund (sacred fire pit for rituals)
- 4 Paat (traditional ceremonial seating platforms)

## Booking Terms
- Hall reservation: 6:00 PM day-1 to 4:00 PM day-2
- Advance: 50% at booking; balance at handover
- Electricity and generator billed separately by consumption
- Band/sound system must stop after 11:00 PM
- Guests responsible for valuables; personal locks recommended
